verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents its own configurable automation: transaction rules automatically approve or decline authorizations without human intervention, and relayed authorisation has configurable fallback logic (default approve or refuse) when your server does not reply within 2000 ms. This is narrow, domain-specific rule automation rather than general background automations. Webhooks and APIs are only building blocks a developer would use to construct their own automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose configurable automations or workflows beyond authorization decisions, scheduled or triggered background jobs, agent-oriented automation features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
